title: Beyond Evidence Coverage: Encoding-Time Access in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.29107v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cache-sharing multi-agent systems can retain every evidence token's representation while preventing cross-worker access during encoding. We test whether this coverage recovers joint-encoding quality using attention masks over two logical workers in frozen Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct models. Tokens, positions, and answer-time access remain fixed within comparisons. We evaluate 200 two-hop MuSiQue-Ans questions and 200 selected HotpotQA bridge questions. In data-layout seed 0, averaged across models, blocking access costs 5.6 and 6.8 F1 points relative to full access on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, respectively. Exposing the earlier worker's supporting paragraph improves F1 over blocked access by 7.6 and 6.7 points; equal-token non-support access provides no detectable average gain. With model weights and greedy decoding fixed, we vary distractor layouts using five data-layout seeds per dataset for Qwen3-8B and three for Llama

translated_title: 超越证据覆盖：多智能体系统中的编码时访问
translated_abstract: 共享缓存的多智能体系统能够保留所有证据token的表示，同时阻止编码过程中的跨工作器访问。我们通过注意力掩码在冻结的Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct模型中对两个逻辑工作器进行实验，测试这种“覆盖”能否恢复联合编码的质量。在各组比较中，token、位置以及回答时的访问保持固定。我们评估了200个两跳MuSiQue-Ans问题和200个精选的HotpotQA桥接问题。在数据布局种子0下，跨模型平均来看，与完全访问相比，阻止访问在MuSiQue和HotpotQA上分别导致5.6和6.8个F1点的损失。暴露先前工作器的支持段落相比阻止访问使F1分别提高7.6和6.7点；而等token数量的非支持内容访问则没有可检测到的平均增益。在模型权重和贪心解码固定的情况下，我们使用每个数据集的五个数据布局种子（Qwen3-8B）和三个种子（Llama）来变换干扰项布局。
tldr: 该研究发现，在共享缓存的多智能体系统中，仅保留所有证据token并不足以替代编码时的实际访问——阻止编码时访问会使多跳问答F1下降约5-7点，而仅暴露先前工作器的支持段落即可恢复绝大部分性能损失，且访问等量无关内容并无增益。
en_tdlr: In cache-sharing multi-agent systems, retaining all evidence tokens is insufficient without encoding-time access—blocking such access degrades multi-hop QA performance by 5-7 F1 points, while exposing just the earlier worker's supporting paragraph recovers most of the loss, with equal-token irrelevant access providing no gain.
